title: dianthus caryophyllus var. longicaulis
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus var. longicaulis, commonly known as Sweet William, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as colds and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sweet William include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus caryophyllus var. longicaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
